
PMID- 26719248
OWN- NLM
STAT- MEDLINE
TI  - Interleukin-6 and autoimmunity: a review of the pathogenic role of IL-6 in
      rheumatoid arthritis.
AB  - Interleukin-6 (IL-6) is a pleiotropic cytokine with a central role in
      rheumatoid arthritis. IL-6 activates JAK/STAT3 signalling in synovial
      tissue, promotes Th17 differentiation and supports B-cell autoantibody
      production. IL-6 receptor blockade reduces C-reactive protein and improves
      tender joint counts in patients with rheumatoid arthritis.
AU  - Hanow I
AU  - Tanaka M
JT  - Journal of Immunology Research
TA  - J Immunol Res
DP  - 2016 Aug
LID - 10.1155/2016/2671924 [doi]
AID - 10.1155/2016/2671924 [doi]
PT  - Journal Article
PT  - Review
SO  - J Immunol Res. 2016;2016:2671924.

PMID- 30123456
OWN- NLM
STAT- MEDLINE
TI  - Randomised controlled trial of interleukin-6 receptor blockade in active
      rheumatoid arthritis.
AB  - In this randomised controlled trial, interleukin-6 receptor blockade improved
      American College of Rheumatology response rates and reduced disease activity
      scores in patients with active rheumatoid arthritis. Serious infection rates
      were modestly increased.
AU  - Okafor A
JT  - Annals of the Rheumatic Diseases
DP  - 2018 Jun
AID - 10.1136/annrheumdis-2018-0001 [doi]
PT  - Randomized Controlled Trial
SO  - Ann Rheum Dis. 2018;77:1-9.
